steps.title: Verify App Metadata Configuration
steps.description: Establish the exact package namespace and metadata layout for Charging Voice Alert.

steps.title: Audit and Clean Project Dependencies
steps.description: Remove non-SDK external third-party dependencies from build.gradle to ensure strict Java and Android SDK compliance.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Declaration Structure
steps.description: Confirm proper declaration of Activities, Services with FGS Type 'specialUse', and Boot Receivers in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Resolve Dynamic Broadcast Receiver Runtime Crash
steps.description: Implement RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flag check inside MainActivity for custom battery update actions on target API 33+ devices.

steps.title: Resolve Foreground Service Start Crash
steps.description: Modify the service call to use startForeground with the specialUse type argument dynamically on Android 14+.

steps.title: Resolve Private Drawable Resource Crash
steps.description: Change notification builder to use public system-safe drawables and avoid potential Resources$NotFoundException crashes.

steps.title: Verify Native Text-to-Speech Engine Support
steps.description: Verify safe asynchronous initialization and language fallback checks for Hindi-language voice announcements.

steps.title: Verify MainActivity UI Lifecycle
steps.description: Review views, buttons, switches, and settings to prevent initialization-order NullPointerExceptions during startup.

steps.title: Verify Boot Receiver Configuration
steps.description: Verify boot completion handler behavior for seamless automatic background monitoring restoration on reboot.

steps.title: Verify Android Theme and Color Styling
steps.description: Verify XML layouts and styles use standard Material Light themes and reliable asset definitions.

steps.title: Building Charging Voice Alert
steps.description: Compile the verified code and assets into the final production-ready APK.
